slides.title: Matrix acceptance before ranking
bullets: Set reference conditions and matrix controls in the study plan.
Review calibration behaviour, blanks and sample suitability together.

slides.title: Microsomal CLint
bullets: Measure depletion in a defined microsomal incubation.
Cofactor dependence and nonspecific loss distinguish metabolism from other loss routes.
Report CLint in µL/min/mg with species and conditions attached.
Flat or very rapid profiles may support bounds rather than precise estimates.
slides.notes: Protein concentration and sampling schedule are selected for the study. No demonstration results are presented.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Hepatocyte depletion CLint
bullets: Use an intact-cell context when the question extends beyond microsomal metabolism.
Record species, cell handling and the suitable depletion interval.
Report CLint in µL/min/10^6 cells.
Do not compare directly with microsomal values without an explicit scaling model.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Choosing the depletion model
bullets: Microsomal CLint: focused assessment of microsomal metabolic loss.
Compare articles within matched incubation conditions.
bullets_right: Hepatocyte depletion CLint: integrated intact-cell context.
Consider when transport or additional metabolic routes affect interpretation.
slides.notes: Neither model alone guarantees in vivo clearance prediction.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: fu,p by equilibrium dialysis
bullets: Measure unbound fraction in the specified plasma matrix.
Assess recovery, equilibration and stability alongside binding.
Low unbound fraction requires suitable analytical sensitivity.
Carry species and matrix into unbound-exposure calculations.
slides.notes: fu,p is dimensionless. Do not silently transfer binding observations between species.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Tandem-MS bioanalytical readiness
bullets: Confirm analyte response in the intended matrix.
Choose calibration range around the sampling question.
Consider dilution, carryover and matrix effects before exposure samples arrive.
Javier Quintana, Mass-Spectrometry Manager, leads analytical planning.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Lower-limit assumptions
bullets: Define how below-quantitation observations enter summaries before reviewing exposure.
Distinguish low measured concentrations from qualified observations.
State imputation or exclusion rules in the DMPK memo.
A terminal phase dominated by qualified observations may not support extrapolation.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Rat exposure with tandem-MS bioanalysis
bullets: Agree route, formulation and sampling against the exposure question.
Retain dosing-lot and accession-lot linkage.
Report integrated exposure in ng·h/mL with the integration convention.
Megan Larkin, DMPK Study Director, connects analytical interpretation to the decision.
